# Model verification (generated by `backend/verify_models.py`)

Independent checks of the production models. Re-run with `python verify_models.py` after `train.py`.

## 1. Data integrity

- 303 patients, 55 inputs, 0 missing values, 0 duplicate patients.
- Label consistency: 0 patients labelled CAD with no stenotic vessel, 1 labelled Normal with a stenotic vessel.
- Prevalence: CAD 71%, LAD 58%, LCX 39%, RCA 38%.

## 2. Leakage

- Target columns among the inputs: none.
- Strongest single inputs (AUC on their own): CAD: Typical Chest Pain 0.80, Age 0.72, Atypical 0.71; LAD: Typical Chest Pain 0.73, EF-TTE 0.71, Age 0.68; LCX: Age 0.68, Typical Chest Pain 0.65, BP 0.62; RCA: Typical Chest Pain 0.65, Neut 0.64, Age 0.64.
- Label-permutation test (full recipe, labels shuffled; ~0.5 expected if nothing leaks): CAD 0.52, LAD 0.48, LCX 0.50, RCA 0.49.

## 3. Fresh-split cross-validation (split seeds 5000-5004, never used in development)

± is the spread across the 5 repeats (split noise); the bootstrap 95% CI is the real uncertainty with 303 patients. New splits of the same patients cannot remove all optimism from choosing the recipe on this data: expect the true AUC to be about 0.005-0.01 lower (0.01-0.02 for RCA).

| Target | AUC fresh 5x5 | AUC saved (train.py) | 95% CI (bootstrap) | Brier (prevalence-only) | Calibration slope / intercept |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CAD | 0.939 ± 0.002 | 0.943 | 0.914–0.967 | 0.087 (0.205) | 1.11 / -0.04 |
| LAD | 0.859 ± 0.006 | 0.856 | 0.822–0.907 | 0.147 (0.243) | 0.92 / -0.00 |
| LCX | 0.745 ± 0.018 | 0.761 | 0.706–0.812 | 0.202 (0.238) | 0.85 / -0.06 |
| RCA | 0.754 ± 0.008 | 0.739 | 0.702–0.811 | 0.193 (0.235) | 1.03 / -0.05 |

## 5. Vessel specificity: which artery, or how much CAD?

| Artery | Its own model (AUC) | CAD model used for this label (AUC) | Own model, CAD patients only (AUC) |
|---|---|---|---|
| LAD | 0.859 | 0.860 | 0.686 |
| LCX | 0.745 | 0.735 | 0.632 |
| RCA | 0.754 | 0.730 | 0.619 |

- In the 87 single-vessel patients, the highest vessel estimate pointed at the right artery 61% of the time, against 66% for always guessing LAD; isolated RCA disease was ranked first in 0/17 patients.
- So the vessel models mostly measure how much coronary disease there is, and only partly which artery. The app therefore shows three independent per-artery estimates and never a 'culprit' vessel.

| Diabetes vs none (RCA model) | RCA | +19.4 pts | + | yes |

Where the model disagrees with the textbook direction, the raw data (CAD rate in this referral cohort) show why; these are learned associations, not causes:

- By chest pain: typical 94% (n=164), atypical 43% (n=93), non-anginal 19% (n=16), none recorded 63% (n=30). Patients referred with no chest pain had other strong reasons for angiography, so 'atypical' is not riskier than 'none recorded' here.
- By LDL (mg/dL): 0-100 73% (n=153), 100-130 68% (n=88), 130-400 73% (n=62). Flat: LDL carries no signal in this cohort, most likely because patients with known disease are already on lipid-lowering treatment.
- By HDL (mg/dL): 0-40 76% (n=169), 40-50 63% (n=93), 50-200 71% (n=41). Weak and non-monotonic.
- Consequence: the app's explanations may show LDL slightly lowering an estimate. That reflects the data, not physiology, and must not be read as advice.

_Run time 99 s._
